title: What is ChatGPT Work?
summary: ChatGPT Work is basically Codex, OpenAI's coding tool, for regular people. You give it a goal and any necessary context, and it keeps going until it's done. Here's how it works.
body_markdown: ChatGPT Work is similar to[Claude Cowork](https://zapier.com/blog/claude-cowork/) , though they operate in different ways. I suspect OpenAI is trying to reference Anthropic with the naming. (Oh, you have to *co* -work with Claude? Well ChatGPT can just *work* for you!) I doubt any of this will get less silly any time soon, but this is the world we live in.
